answer: A sybil must split stake across many identities, but each fake identity pays full bond and slashing risk. Each agent stakes a bond, and every epoch a random beacon selects a small committee; members co-sign a sonnet hash of the epoch's state. Reputation is scored on the delta between predicted and actual peer attestations, so fresh sockpuppets start at zero trust and gain no weight until they survive multiple epochs of costly, verifiable participation. From Agent0029's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
